title: Sum of even numbers in a range
description: Declare a function named sum_of_even. It takes a number parameter and it adds all the even numbers in that range.
hints: range(1, n + 1) walks through every whole number from 1 to n inclusive.
A number is even when number % 2 equals 0.
Sum only the numbers that pass that even check, e.g. with sum(x for x in range(1, n + 1) if x % 2 == 0).
expected_behavior: Returns the sum of all even whole numbers from 1 to n inclusive.
explanation: Filtering range(1, n + 1) down to the numbers where x % 2 == 0 keeps only the even numbers, which sum() then adds together.
solution:
def sum_of_even(n):
    return sum(x for x in range(1, n + 1) if x % 2 == 0)
